App Preferences
Mode
Dark is the default. Light reverses the app into a blue-tinted light scheme.
Distance Units
Used for cardio exercises (run, bike, row, etc). Miles gives a single unit; Km also lets you choose Metres per exercise for shorter distances.
Linked Services
Anthropic API Key
Anthropic API key
Optional. Enables the "Ask BLOC for advice" feature on the Progress page. Stored only on this device. Get a key at console.anthropic.com — billed separately from Claude Pro, but each call costs under $0.01.
